fusions.name: Vise Grip
fusions.desc: A clamping bite that deals 13 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrenching Clench
fusions.desc: A wrenching bite that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Gentle Carry
fusions.desc: Removes 1 condition from you and 1 from each of your allies.

fusions.name: Sure Seizure
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
